question: ________ is the place of confluence for river Alaknanda and Dhauliganga.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Vishnuprayag.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Vishnuprayag** is the place where **Alaknanda River** meets **Dhauliganga River.**
 
• It is located in **Chamoli district **of **Uttarakhand.**​
 
• Alaknanda River is one of the **two headstreams** of the **Ganges.**
 
• Dhauliganga River originates from the **Niti Pass in Uttarakhand.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Nandaprayag:**

 
 
• It is the place where **Alaknanda River** meets **Nandakini River.**
 
• It is located in** Chamoli district** of Uttarakhand.
 
 
 
• **Karnaprayag: **
 
 
• It is the place where **Alaknanda River** meets **Pindar River.**
 
• It is located in **Chamoli district** of Uttarakhand.
 
 
 
• **Rudraprayag:**
 
 
• It is the place where **Alaknanda River** meets **Mandakini River.**
 
• It is located in **Rudraprayag **district of Uttarakhand.
